governance: Existing Genesis authority/timelock; no new approver or delay
route_activation: Stage inactive, qualify exact adapter/verifier/configuration, activate with atomic binding. ACTIVE label alone never authorizes execution.
execution: Live canonical registry, chain, runtime, implementation, configuration and exact route checks before and after verification/dispatch and at positive transfer lifecycle advancement.
lifecycle: Only canonical trusted router creates transfers or asserts VERIFIED. Exact original transfer qualification remains pinned through settlement. Operators cannot supply substitute proof authorization.
recovery: Both-direction disable, suspension, pause, dispute, expiry and governed refund remain available after qualification drift. Positive recovery cannot restore stale approval.
chain_orientation: One exact recorded endpoint must be the executing chain; local source and local destination orientations supported.
cadc: Explicit qualification binding for activation; requireActive for live use; public configuration commitment and audited dependency manifest. No issuer authorization implied.
unsupported: Legacy placeholder adapters revert. Unsupported protocol receipt/finality paths confer no settlement authorization.
